subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: Should OpenClaw add an admin-scoped all-session auth refresh API, and what session/auth state may it invalidate while preserving context?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the safe behavior crosses credential ownership, explicit per-session pins, transcript continuity, Gateway protocol scope, and provider routing policy.

options.title: Add admin auth refresh contract
options.body: Define a sessions.refreshAuth-style API with all-sessions scope, explicit stale-state ownership rules, and regression coverage for context preservation and credential invalidation.

options.title: Fold into provider-switch transaction
options.body: Make provider/auth switching own session refresh as part of one transaction, reducing standalone API surface but tying the behavior to switch workflows.

options.title: Keep per-session reset only
options.body: Leave current reset behavior unchanged and document per-session recovery, accepting continued multi-channel auth-switch friction.

recommendation.title: Add admin auth refresh contract
recommendation.body: Define a sessions.refreshAuth-style API with all-sessions scope, explicit stale-state ownership rules, and regression coverage for context preservation and credential invalidation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history signal on Gateway reset semantics and auth-driven CLI session invalidation.
